$comment: EXP-1275 + EXP-1271 + FEED-79 (EXP-1259 D8-D11): THE feedback-states system x4, one styleguide section "Feedback states" on every styleguide (web apps/styleguide, IDE styleguide, iOS + Android styleguide screens) and in the eUI catalog for the low-level three (Spinner, Button pending, Skeleton). Six kinds, nothing else draws a wait or an error. (1) INLINE: a `inline.spinner` px spinner + a progressive word in a band, header or caption (`Saving` then `Saved`); the EXP-1274 list-head spinner (GlassSectionHeader loading) IS this primitive. (2) PENDING: a button that started something swaps its icon slot for the spinner and its label for the progressive word (`pending.words`), its width never changes (it keeps its idle width as a minimum), and nothing changes before `pending.delayMs` so a fast action never flashes; disabled while pending. (3) PLACEHOLDER: skeleton rows in the real row geometry (the row's own height, a dot where its glyph sits, bars where its text sits, `placeholder.barHeight` px bars at radius `placeholder.radius` in the muted fill) pulsing opacity `placeholder.opacity` over `placeholder.pulseMs` ease-in-out, static at `placeholder.reducedOpacity` under reduce motion; it replaces EVERY 'Loading...' text and the phones' centred first-load spinners (empty-state.json's first-load rule now reads: skeleton x4). (4) THE MARK: the logo disc (foreground) whose three cut stripes sweep per `mark` (timeline = pure `markStripeSpan`, TS reference packages/domain-contract/src/feedback-mark.ts, mirrors replay `mark.cases`): each stripe is the logo's cubic `cubic` (100x100 grid, the disc = circle r 50 at 50,50 clips it), cut in the CALLER's ground colour (or a destination-out mask) at `mark.stripeWidth` grid units, drawn only over its visible span [t0,t1] of the cubic's parameter (sampled at `mark.samples` steps); loop `mark.loopMs`, linear phase; reduce motion = the static logo (all three spans [0,1]). Used for `starting` (the composer after Start + the run status row before the first turn) and `blocking`. (5) BLOCKING: a full-window backdrop (the window ground at `blocking.backdropOpacity`) + the mark at `blocking.markSize` + ONE muted line (`blocking.copy`), only for switching team, switching account and signing out; never for a single list or button. (6) ERRORS (FEED-79): `errors.rule`. Toasts per toast-stack.json (kind error, the ui-error icon). AUTOSAVE (D9, the IDE + web team prompt and every autosaving long text field): save `autosave.debounceMs` after the last keystroke and on blur; the caption reads `Saving` (inline spinner) -> `Saved` for `autosave.savedHoldMs` -> `Edited {ago}` (the platform's existing relative-time formatter); there is NO Unsaved state and no Save button. REMOTE START (D11, desktop only): a run started on this device by anything but THIS window's own composer never takes the window; it shows in Running with the starting spinner and raises an info toast (`remoteStart`).

errors.rule: ONLY a failure of something the PERSON just did toasts. Automatic or background work (trunk sync, polling, refresh on open or on focus, heartbeats, prefetch, live reloads) NEVER toasts: it keeps its existing quiet surface (the IDE trunk_sync badge + banner, a list's band spinner, its empty state). A FAILED ACTION (save, delete, start, connect, merge, send, invite, sign-in request that reached the server) = toast.error(title, {description: the server's message, action: Retry when re-running the same call is safe}). Title = `Couldn't <verb> <thing>` (sentence case, no period). INVALID INPUT stays INLINE under its field in the rose foreground at 13px (a red field border + the line), never a toast: auth forms, the invite email, URL fields, byte caps, required fields, names already taken. Nothing else renders an error inline: no rose sentences in settings sections, dialogs, option lines, pickers or faces; a section whose automatic LOAD failed shows its empty state (plus its Retry); only a failed Retry tap toasts.
